summary: Costamare Bulkers Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting second-quarter 2026 financial results and operational updates, including a vessel sale agreement for the 2009-built dry bulk vessel Bermondi expected to close in Q3 2026. This is a routine earnings release, not a special-situation transaction. The filing also notes completion of a previously announced transaction with Cargill and provides fleet details. No acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review is being announced. The vessel sale is a single-vessel disposal in the ordinary course of business. No deal terms or premiums disclosed. What to watch: no special-situation angle; the sale is immaterial and routine.
